info.description: SIR spreading over a Watts-Strogatz network (Population Person agents, `network`: "small_world", degree K, rewiring Beta): a Susceptible only ever becomes Infected by MESSAGE from a linked neighbour, sent the instant that neighbour recovers (`send("infect", "links")` on its own I->R transition) -- so infection rides the network structure itself, not a mean-field rate. Beta=0 collapses the network to a plain ring (each agent linked to its K nearest) and, with a CONSTANT recovery time instead of an exponential one, the outbreak becomes a deterministic wavefront: node at ring-distance d recovers at exactly (d + 1) * Recovery time, so Recovered(t) is an EXACT closed form, not a Monte Carlo estimate -- the oracle this asset ships with. The default instance (Beta 0.1) is an ordinary small-world outbreak, faster and larger than the pure ring since the rewired long-range links shortcut the front; Degree, Beta, Recovery time, Population and Initial infected are this instance's own.

parameters.name: degree
parameters.label: Degree K
parameters.help: Each agent links to its K nearest ring neighbours before rewiring (even).

parameters.name: beta
parameters.label: Rewiring beta
parameters.help: Probability each ring link is rewired to a random agent (0 = a plain ring).

parameters.name: recovery_time
parameters.label: Recovery time
parameters.help: Fixed duration an Infected agent stays infectious.

parameters.name: initial_infected
parameters.label: Initial Infected
parameters.help: Agents that start Infected; the rest start Susceptible.
